claim: Quality-gated outcome routing rejects a nominally cheap route when mature receipts show regression or incomplete cost telemetry, while preserving it when eligible.
old_policy: Choose the configured route with the lowest nominal per-call cost, without outcome-quality or complete-attempt denominators.
new_policy: Filter by mature reliability, escapes, repairs, complete cost and wall time; then minimize all-attempt cost per reliable outcome.
pass_rule: All 18 deterministic arm-scenario cells match; any mismatch blocks the selector-mechanism claim.
limits: This isolates selector logic with synthetic receipts and zero model calls.
It does not prove one provider or model is better.
Real ROI is reported only by the separate frozen real-task artifact and live terminal receipts.
